title: The Vatican's Website in Latin
summary: The Vatican's official website maintains a Latin version (vatican.va/latin/latin_index.html), reflecting the Catholic Church's continued use of Latin as its official liturgical and administrative language. The post received 151 points and 88 comments from the Hacker News community.
problem_solved: Preserves access to Vatican content in classical Latin for scholars, theologians, and language enthusiasts.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how an ancient language continues to serve a modern institution, bridging historical and contemporary communication.
